主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. and Forest City Realty Trust, Inc. announced an acquisition agreement. Brookfield Fund will acquire Forest City for $25.35 per share in a $11.4 billion transaction. The portfolio includes 18,500 multifamily units and 10.8 million square feet of prime office, life science, and retail space in major U.S. cities. The purchase price represents a 26.6% premium over Forest City's closing share price of $20.03 on June 15, 2018. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2018. Forest City's shareholders, including affiliates of Starboard Value LP and Scopia Capital Management LP, which collectively own about 14% of Forest City’s shares, have agreed to support the merger. The transaction is subject to stockholder approval but not contingent on financing. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include BAM.
